source: Cabinet Decision No. 85 of 2022 · FTA TRC service
headline: A UAE VISA DOESN'T
MAKE YOU

blocks.text: I have a UAE visa, so I'm a UAE tax resident.
You need to meet one test

items: **183 days** or more in the UAE in 12 months
**90 days** or more, plus a visa and a UAE home, job or business
Your **main home and centre of interests** are in the UAE
